author: Roszczyk
title: Debian Packages install fails - Unable to connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com

failed_jobs.name: Debian Packages / Debian Packages
failed_jobs.symptom: apt-get could not fetch perl_5.38.2-3.2ubuntu0.7_amd64.deb from security.ubuntu.com because the azure.archive.ubuntu.com mirror was unreachable, failing the 'Install debian packages & check conflicts' step with exit code 100.

key_errors:
Err:5 http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu noble-updates/main amd64 perl amd64 5.38.2-3.2ubuntu0.7
  Unable to connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:http:

E: Failed to fetch http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/p/perl/perl_5.38.2-3.2ubuntu0.7_amd64.deb  Unable to connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:http:
E: Unable to fetch some archives, maybe run apt-get update or try with --fix-missing?
##[error]Process completed with exit code 100.
root_cause: The 'Install debian packages & check conflicts' step in the Debian Packages job runs apt-get inside an Ubuntu 24.04 container that relies on the azure.archive.ubuntu.com mirror as the primary apt source. During this run the Azure-hosted mirror was transiently unreachable (no DNS/TCP error, just repeated 'Unable to connect' on the perl package), while retries against archive.ubuntu.com and security.ubuntu.com for other packages eventually succeeded after multi-minute stalls (8-9 minutes total fetch time). The job is unrelated to the PR's GPU grid_sample kernel change - purely an upstream Azure apt mirror outage/instability causing an infrastructure-level network failure in the merge-queue CI.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; requires the same transient azure.archive.ubuntu.com mirror outage inside the CI's ubuntu24 Docker container. To inspect: docker run the ubuntu24 CI image and run 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y <debian packages>' while the mirror is degraded.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Debian Packages' job (handled automatically by remediate_transient_failure for this investigation).

Consider adding automatic apt mirror fallback/retry (e.g., apt::Acquire::Retries or switching to archive.ubuntu.com directly) in the Debian Packages job's Dockerfile/step to reduce sensitivity to azure.archive.ubuntu.com outages.
Monitor recurrence via the ci-doctor-mq pattern database; this exact signature has now been seen 2 times (Aug 19 and Nov 23).
prevention_strategies: Configure apt to use multiple mirrors with automatic fallback (e.g., mirror:// protocol or apt-cacher-ng) instead of relying solely on azure.archive.ubuntu.com, and/or increase Acquire::Retries and Acquire::http::Timeout so transient mirror hiccups resolve without failing the whole job.
historical_context: This exact signature (c8d00529252cfb02) was first recorded on 2026-08-19 (run 32234143786, PR #37396) and related azure.archive.ubuntu.com connectivity failures have recurred at least 9 times total across similar hash variants since August 2026, confirming this is a recurring upstream Azure apt-mirror reliability issue rather than a one-off.
